description: Assessment of observable steps performed during a standard handwashing procedure.

criteria.name: Hand Preparation
criteria.description: Learner positions both hands appropriately to begin the handwashing procedure.

criteria.name: Back of Hand Rubbing
criteria.description: Learner rubs the back of each hand.

criteria.name: Interlaced Finger Rubbing
criteria.description: Learner rubs hands with fingers interlaced.

criteria.name: Procedure Completion
criteria.description: Learner completes the defined handwashing sequence.
